changelog:
ai-image-realism v0.2.6

- Expanded and clarified documentation describing the editing workflow, key priorities (such as preservation of identity and branding), and decision points for repairing AI-generated image artifacts.
- Outlines must-keep elements, confirmation needs, edit region logic, and revision flows.
- Details best practices for handling plastic skin, malformed hands, repeated textures, and other common issues.
- Documents safe automatic updates and bundled client usage.
- Adds a comprehensive reference section for troubleshooting, task management, and recovery.
summary: Improve AI image realism without starting over. This focused AI image editor and humanizer targets visible AI image artifacts—plastic skin, malformed hands or faces, extra fingers, repeated textures, and inconsistent lighting—with focused AI image retouching through a local repair or natural whole-image refinement. Use it to make AI portraits, product images, marketing graphics, and social covers look more realistic, remove the obvious AI look, fix AI hands and extra fingers, or refine product imagery, while aiming to keep identity, product shape, brand details, and composition recognizable where possible.
